Backgrounds.heading: Animated React background components
Backgrounds.description: Aurora, beams, meteors, vortex, waves, grids and particle fields for hero and CTA sections. Each is a lightweight backdrop you drop into a relative section — canvas loops pause offscreen and stop under reduced motion.

Text.heading: Animated text components for React
Text.description: Typewriters, flipping and rotating words, scramble, shimmer, gradient and highlight effects. Screen readers always get the stable text, and rotating copy pauses on hover and focus.

Buttons.heading: Animated React button components
Buttons.description: Shimmer, rainbow, ripple, magnetic and moving-border buttons, a promise-aware stateful button and a View Transitions theme toggle. Real buttons with focus rings, ready for your CTAs.

Cards & Layout.heading: Animated React card and layout components
Cards & Layout.description: Bento grids, spotlight, tilt, glare and wobble cards, marquees, docks, focus and hover grids, expandable and draggable cards. Pointer effects are decorative; content and links stay accessible.

Navigation.heading: Animated React navigation components
Navigation.description: Floating and resizable navbars, a morphing menu, an animated sidebar and tabs. Keyboard support follows the WAI-ARIA patterns: Escape closes, focus returns, arrow keys move between tabs.

Forms.heading: Animated React form components
Forms.description: A vanishing search input, a drag-and-drop file zone and a multi-step stepper — labelled, keyboard-reachable and styled with your shadcn tokens.

Overlays.heading: Animated React modal components
Overlays.description: A modal built on the native <dialog> element: it lives in the browser's top layer, traps focus, closes on Escape and plays its exit animation before it closes.

Loaders.heading: React loader and loading-state components
Loaders.description: Dots, pulse, orbit, bars and spinner loaders plus a multi-step loader that announces each step to screen readers. Under reduced motion they fade instead of moving, so progress is still visible.

Social Proof.heading: React testimonial and social proof components
Social Proof.description: Animated testimonials with a visible pause button, tweet-style cards and logo clouds — no third-party embeds, no API calls, no layout shift.

Scroll.heading: Scroll animation components for React
Scroll.description: Hero parallax, MacBook scroll, timelines, sticky scroll, tracing beams, scroll progress and velocity marquees. Scroll-linked transforms turn off under reduced motion with no hydration mismatch.

Effects.heading: React UI effect components
Effects.description: Border beams, animated connection beams, blur-fade reveals and a pointer-following glowing border — small effects that add polish to cards and sections.

3D.heading: 3D card components for React
3D.description: Perspective cards whose layers lift to different depths and a pin card with a rising label — CSS 3D transforms, no WebGL and no three.js.

Carousels.heading: React carousel and slider components
Carousels.description: An Apple-style card carousel with an accessible dialog, a full-bleed image slider with a pause button, and a 3D marquee wall.

Cursor & Pointer.heading: Custom cursor and pointer components for React
Cursor & Pointer.description: A lens magnifier, multiplayer-style following pointers, a smooth custom cursor and pointer highlights. They only activate for mouse and trackpad users and never hide the cursor on touch.

Data & Maps.heading: React globe and world map components
Data & Maps.description: A dependency-free canvas globe with markers, arcs and drag-to-spin, and an SVG world map with animated connections. No WebGL, no map library — the land data is embedded.

Mockups.heading: React device mockup and code block components
Mockups.description: Browser and iPhone frames, an animated terminal and a code block with tabs, line highlights and built-in syntax highlighting — for product screenshots and docs.
